title: Vary the wording of each request
statement: Test a generator with several phrasings of each request, since its quality should not depend on how a request is worded.
example: One maths benchmark varies each request's wording, difficulty and type, for more than 4,000 requests in all.
detail: A maths benchmark's request set covers 672 skills and varies each request by difficulty, item type and semantic variation, describing the same skills and topics 'in various semantically similar ways' (`icloud-work/incept/incept-uae-api-website/bench.inceptapi.com/Incept Pedagogy & Learning Science Overview.md`). It is a design; no result from it is recorded.
against: No results were recorded for the benchmark that uses it: its results table reads '| Coming Soon | - | - | - | - |' (`icloud-work/incept/incept-uae-api-website/bench.inceptapi.com/content/english/pages/uae-mathematics.md`, line 131).

evidence.quote: Semantic variation \- The same skills and topics are described in various semantically similar ways while sending requests to the LLM
The entire curriculum for Mathematics across grades 3-8 is divided into a granular list of 672 unique skills.
Including all variations, the benchmark covers \> 4000 question generation requests.
